blocks.html: This CryptPad instance is unique — it exists only on this Deploy App server. All data stays on your own infrastructure and disappears completely when the server is shut down. The following is a simple, effective way to use CryptPad in your unit: as the person responsible for the command system, start by creating a top-level team.

slides.title: Create a team for your unit (1/8)
slides.html: Create a team for your unit in CryptPad. This gives you a shared drive and calendar easily. Start by finding the Teams menu in the top-right corner.

slides.title: Create a team for your unit (2/8)
slides.html: The Teams menu shows the CryptPad teams you belong to. Create a new one.

slides.title: Create a team for your unit (3/8)
slides.html: Give your team a descriptive name and continue.

slides.title: Create a team for your unit (4/8)
slides.html: Your team is created and visible in the teams menu. Continue by clicking your team's icon.

slides.title: Create a team for your unit (5/8)
slides.html: Here you'll find your team's shared drive. Next, navigate to the Members menu to create an invitation to your team.

slides.title: Create a team for your unit (6/8)
slides.html: To let others join your team, create an invite link. The image shows our recommended settings. Press Create link to generate a shareable invite link.

slides.title: Create a team for your unit (7/8)
slides.html: Copy the link and share it via your preferred messaging service. The recipient must be on your unit's Deploy App server — without Deploy App's mTLS certificate, your CryptPad cannot be accessed, for security reasons.

slides.title: Create a team for your unit (8/8)
slides.html: This is what the joining member's view looks like. After this, they will see your team's shared drive.
